title: Idempotent Peer/deliver: dedup path has zero test coverage
description: The idempotency guard in DeliverHandler (find_by_sender_msg_id → early return) was the core feature of commit 6cda7d4 but is never exercised by any test. The test deliver_same_chat_id_same_sender_accepted sends two messages with different sender msg_ids — it tests 'second message in chat', not 'retransmitted message'. A retransmitted deliver with the same sender_msg_id has never been tested. If the guard is removed or broken, all tests still pass.
